reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Kansas
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Does the law regulating residential evictions specify the type(s) of landlord(s) regulated?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (facts)
   ========================= */

scenario_state(kansas).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_topic(residential_evictions).

/* For this QA, treat the following Kansas acts/definition sections as the relevant
   "law regulating residential evictions" because eviction regulation in landlord-tenant
   law depends on who qualifies as a "landlord". */
scenario_relevant_statute(ks_stat_58_2543_2021).     % Kansas Residential Landlord and Tenant Act definitions
scenario_relevant_statute(ks_stat_58_25_103_2021).   % Mobile home park landlord-tenant act definitions

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded factual scenario is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(kansas),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_topic(residential_evictions),
    scenario_relevant_statute(ks_stat_58_2543_2021),
    scenario_relevant_statute(ks_stat_58_25_103_2021).

/* =========================
   Statutes translation
   (deterministic predicates capturing definitions relevant to "type(s) of landlord(s)")
   ========================= */

/* --- KS Stat  58-2543 (2021), definition of "Landlord"
   "Landlord" means:
     - owner
     - lessor
     - sublessor
     of the dwelling unit (or building of which it is a part),
   and also:
     - manager who fails to disclose as required by K.S.A. 58-2551
*/
statute_ks_58_2543_landlord_type(owner).
statute_ks_58_2543_landlord_type(lessor).
statute_ks_58_2543_landlord_type(sublessor).
statute_ks_58_2543_landlord_type(manager_who_fails_to_disclose).

/* --- KS Stat  58-25,103 (2021), definition of "Landlord" (mobile home park context)
   "Landlord" means:
     - owner
     - lessor
     - sublessor
     of a mobile home park,
   and also:
     - manager of the mobile home park who fails to disclose as required by K.S.A. 58-25,109
*/
statute_ks_58_25_103_landlord_type(owner).
statute_ks_58_25_103_landlord_type(lessor).
statute_ks_58_25_103_landlord_type(sublessor).
statute_ks_58_25_103_landlord_type(manager_who_fails_to_disclose).

/* Map each relevant statute to its landlord-type predicate. */
statute_landlord_type(ks_stat_58_2543_2021, Type) :-
    statute_ks_58_2543_landlord_type(Type).
statute_landlord_type(ks_stat_58_25_103_2021, Type) :-
    statute_ks_58_25_103_landlord_type(Type).

/* The "law regulating residential evictions" specifies landlord types if, among the statutes
   relevant to the scenario, at least one statute provides one or more landlord categories. */
law_specifies_landlord_types_for_scenario :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_relevant_statute(Statute),
    statute_landlord_type(Statute, _Type),
    !.

/* =========================
   Answer derivation (deterministic)
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    law_specifies_landlord_types_for_scenario,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law regulating residential evictions specify the type(s) of landlord(s) regulated?
